name: @treeai/studio
description: TreeAI Studio — D3 Core MVP local web surface. Create/open a Tree, converse on the Trunk, branch from an anchored answer selection, continue the branch, navigate back, edit and explicitly submit a Return to the Trunk; all product state persisted in the TreeAI database. Offline echo driver by default (deterministic, no network); optional real Pi driver. Scope is honest: no automated summaries, no PDF/search/installers.

scripts.test: npm run build:deps && npm run typecheck && node --test tests/*.test.ts
